annotations.title: Ask to remove or correct data

description: Asks Agentosaurus to delete or fix someone's personal data, or to take down an organisation's listing, for the requester or for someone they act for. We email the requester's address a link to confirm; nothing is stored as consent until they click it, and the request is acted on after that. A person reviews it and replies by email within one month; nothing is removed automatically. Returns a reference code only. Limited to 5 per hour per address.

on_behalf_of.description: The person or organisation the requester acts for.

submitted_by_agent.description: An AI agent is sending this request.

target_url_or_slug.description: The page URL or organisation slug the request is about.
